story.summaryEn:
Building the bridge to AI impact.
Introducing our @Cognizant #USGP livery, celebrating five years of bringing people, ideas and technology together.
Built on collaboration and inspired by what comes next.
detailZh:
构建通往人工智能影响的桥梁。
推出我们的 @Cognizant #USGP 车队涂装，庆祝将人们、想法和技术汇聚在一起的五周年。
建立在合作之上，并受到未来可能发生的事情的启发。
detailEn:
Building the bridge to AI impact.
Introducing our @Cognizant #USGP livery, celebrating five years of bringing people, ideas and technology together.
Built on collaboration and inspired by what comes next.
